summary: Session state predicate with no arguments: returns true (1) when dword_5C329C (the count of active slots) is not positive, or when every one of the first dword_5C329C pointers in the dword_7C54F0 array points to a vehicle whose dword at byte offset 16484 (0x4064) is nonzero. Returns false (0) as soon as one active vehicle's +0x4064 dword is zero. Invoked from session end-condition evaluation paths.

operations.description: Initialize the loop index v0 = 0 and the default result = 1 before the count check.
Guard on dword_5C329C > 0; when the active-slot count is not positive the loop is skipped and the default true is returned.
Scan v0 across the first dword_5C329C entries of the dword_7C54F0 pointer array while each entry's dword at byte offset 16484 (0x4064) is nonzero.
Inside the loop, increment v0 and return the default true once v0 reaches dword_5C329C, i.e. every active entry had a nonzero +0x4064 dword.
Return false when an active entry's +0x4064 dword is zero (the loop exits without index exhaustion).
Return the default true when the count is not positive or the index reaches the count.
Called by SessionCheckEndCondition (0x0046D0D0) and ConditionalVirtualDispatchWithStateCheck (0x0046D360) while evaluating session end conditions.

unresolved: Meaning of the per-vehicle dword at byte offset 16484 (0x4064) is unknown here; a nonzero value is required for a true result and likely flags a completed/retired state, but that is not evidenced in the packet.
dword_5C329C is treated as the count of active slots because it bounds the scan of the dword_7C54F0 pointer array; its exact semantics are inferred, not named in the packet.
